d: Job Category Food and Beverage & Culinary
Location Yas Island, Abu dhabi 131808, United Arab EmiratesVIEW ON MAP

Prepare drink orders for guests according to specified recipes using measuring systems. Issue, open, and serve wine/champagne bottles. Set up and maintain cleanliness and condition of bar, bar unit, tables, and other tools. Prepare fresh garnishes for drinks. Stock ice, glassware, and paper supplies. Transport supplies to bar set-up area. Wash soiled glassware. Remove soiled wares from bar top and tables and place in designated area. Anticipate and communicate replenishment needs. Process all payment methods. Count bank at end of shift, complete designated cashier reports, resolve any discrepancies, drop off receipts, and secure bank. Secure liquors, beers, wines, coolers, cabinets, and storage areas. Complete closing duties.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

d: Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and retain customers at scale. Unlike tools that just surface insights, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary AI capabilities, helping teams take action and improve customer experiences across marketing, support, and research.

As we scale globally, building reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure is a top priority. DevOps is a core pillar of our engineering strategy, and we are investing heavily in deployment pipelines, observability, and operational efficiency across all products.

Our engineering teams deliver fast-moving, AI-driven products, and the backbone of their speed and reliability is solid infrastructure and automation. As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll ensure our systems scale seamlessly, deployments happen without friction, and incidents are caught before they impact users. You’ll enable our teams to move faster, focus on building features, and trust that the platform is rock-solid.
You’ll be part of shaping the operational culture at Lucidya, where automation, reliability, and proactive problem solving aren’t just buzzwords, they’re outcomes we obsess over every day.
q: Experienced: You have 5–7 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or a related role.
Hands-On: You have practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
Proactive Problem Solver: You can investigate common technical issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions while knowing when to escalate complex problems.
Collaborative: You work closely with developers and other engineers to support deployments and improve infrastructure reliability.
Curious & Growth-Oriented: You are eager to learn, improve existing systems, and develop your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and observability.
Quality-Focused: You understand the importance of reliable deployments, infrastructure security, monitoring, and operational documentation.
CI/CD: Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or improving CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar.
Containers & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes, including application deployments, configurations, and troubleshooting.
Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, such as AWS or GCP.
Scripting & Automation: Ability to write basic automation scripts using Bash or Python.
Monitoring & Observability: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or similar.
Configuration Management: Basic knowledge of tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
Linux & Networking: Working knowledge of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
Version Control: Experience using Git and working with collaborative software development workflows.
Experience working in a SaaS, product-based, or AI-driven environment.

Familiarity with advanced monitoring, observability, and incident management practices.

d: The Senior Logistics Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and control of all project logistics activities, including international freight forwarding, heavy-lift transportation, customs clearance, warehousing, materials management, site logistics, and project cargo operations. The role ensures safe, timely, and cost-effective delivery of materials and equipment for EPC oil and gas projects.
Develop logistics strategies aligned with project schedules, budgets, and execution plans.
Lead and develop logistics, warehouse, and materials management teams.
Coordinate with Procurement, Expediting, Engineering, Construction, and Project Controls teams.
Manage heavy-lift, out-of-gauge (OOG), breakbulk, charter vessel, airfreight, and project cargo operations.
Review route surveys, lifting studies, transport engineering, and method statements.
Obtain transport permits, escort arrangements, and customs approvals.
Manage warehouses, pipe yards, preservation programs, inventory, and material issuance.
Oversee HAZMAT handling in compliance with IMDG, IATA, and applicable regulations.
Manage 3PLs (Third-Party Logistics Providers), freight forwarders, customs brokers, and shipping agents.
Liaise with ports, shipping lines, airlines, and regulatory authorities.
Negotiate transport contracts and logistics service agreements.
Manage project logistics budgets, cost forecasting, and cost reporting.
Ensure compliance with Incoterms 2020, customs regulations, and import/export controls.
Develop logistics dashboards and KPI reporting through SAP/ERP systems.
Drive HSE excellence and risk mitigation plans for critical shipments.
Provide logistics input to project schedules, progress reports, and senior management updates.

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional certifications such as CLTD, PMP, FIATA, IMDG, or heavy-lift/project cargo certifications are preferred.

Minimum 12 years of logistics and supply chain experience, including at least 5 active years in a managerial role within Oil & Gas, EPC, pipeline, refinery, LNG, petrochemical, or energy infrastructure projects. Acquaintance with procurement process for better performance.

Incoterms 2020, marine chartering, breakbulk operations, project cargo management, SAP/ERP systems, inventory management, customs compliance, IMDG, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations, SOLAS requirements, route surveys, heavy-lift transportation, transport engineering, contract management, vendor management, and logistics cost control.

Leadership, strategic planning, stakeholder management, analytical problem solving, commercial awareness, decision making under pressure, negotiation skills, effective communication, teamwork, and adaptability.
Significant domestic and international travel, including to ports, fabrication yards, and project sites, is required. The role may require work outside normal hours during critical shipment windows.

On-Time Delivery, Logistics Cost Variance, Customs Clearance Cycle Time, Inventory Accuracy, Transportation Damage Rate, Critical Shipment Recovery Rate, HSE Incident Rate, and Supplier Logistics Performance.
